assumptions.assumption: The dispatch console presents a web interface because it is explicitly described as a browser-based single-page JavaScript app.
assumptions.basis: The node is named "Dispatch console (single-page JS app, browser)".

assumptions.assumption: The schedule importer is a non-web process because it performs scheduled import and pull behavior rather than presenting a web interface.
assumptions.basis: It is described as a schedule importer with an hourly pull and parsing behavior.

assumptions.assumption: The Dispatch API handles business-critical data and personal data because it exchanges job orders and crew data.
assumptions.basis: The API exchanges job orders and crews; the database is stated to contain crew names and crew mobile numbers.

assumptions.assumption: The dispatch console handles business-critical data because it receives live job status and calls the Dispatch API.
assumptions.basis: The console receives live job status and makes API calls to the Dispatch API.

assumptions.assumption: The schedule importer handles business-critical data because it processes planned work and work orders.
assumptions.basis: It receives planned work, downloads XML documents, and sends parsed work orders.

assumptions.assumption: The scheduling partner carries business-critical data because it is the source of planned work.
assumptions.basis: The diagram shows the partner sending planned work and participating in an hourly pull.

assumptions.assumption: The dispatch database holds business-critical data and personal data because it contains job orders, crew names, and crew mobile numbers.
assumptions.basis: The node explicitly names job orders, crew names, and crew mobile numbers.

assumptions.assumption: The dispatch database is confidential because it contains crew names and crew mobile numbers.
assumptions.basis: The stated crew names and mobile numbers are personal data.

assumptions.assumption: The schedule archive holds business-critical data because it stores downloaded XML documents from the schedule importer.
assumptions.basis: The archive stores downloaded XML documents associated with planned work.

assumptions.assumption: The live job status flow carries business-critical data because it is explicitly labelled live job status.
assumptions.basis: The flow label is "live job status".

assumptions.assumption: The job orders and crews flows carry business-critical data and personal data because they are labelled job orders and crews and connect to the stated database contents.
assumptions.basis: The flow is labelled "job orders, crews" and the database contains crew names and mobile numbers.

assumptions.assumption: The reverse job orders and crews flow carries business-critical data and personal data for the same stated contents.
assumptions.basis: The bidirectional diagram interaction is labelled "job orders, crews" and the database contains crew names and mobile numbers.

assumptions.assumption: The hourly pull flow carries business-critical data because it participates in obtaining planned work from the scheduling partner.
assumptions.basis: The flow is an hourly pull associated with the partner's planned-work exchange.

assumptions.assumption: The planned work flow carries business-critical data because it is explicitly labelled planned work.
assumptions.basis: The flow label is "planned work (XML)".

assumptions.assumption: The downloaded XML documents flow carries business-critical data because it sends schedule documents to the archive.
assumptions.basis: The flow is labelled "downloaded XML documents" and targets the schedule archive.

assumptions.assumption: The parsed work orders flow carries business-critical data because it is explicitly labelled parsed work orders.
assumptions.basis: The flow label is "parsed work orders".
